messages.text:
I planted 2 packs of seeds and got not 1 plant

 On Sat, Apr 4, 2026, 8:30 AM Lasclay <hey@lasclay.com> wrote:

 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Hello KELLY, 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Hope you're doing well on this Saturday morning.

 Well, the monarch Spring migration has officially begun! There have been sightings all over Southern USA (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KNC6QS6BW8DW65X2VTNXDE4Q_0): in Texas, California, Georgia and South Carolina. 

 They will fly and fly further North in the next few months until they reach our milkweed plantations around mid-May, where they will breed happily all summer long until they migrate again and we can harvest the precious milkweed silk to make insulated products (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KNC6QS6BW8DW65X2VTNXDE4Q_1) 🦋♥️

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Our National Milkweed Planting Campaign is going pretty well too. Thousands of people have already ordered their milkweed seeds to start their monarch butterfly garden.

 
 To encourage even more people to do so, we are pleased to offer discounts of 40 to 50% on milkweed seeds for a few days only. Hurry, it won't last long! 👇 

 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Buy milkweed seeds, start a butterfly garden (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KNC6QS6BW8DW65X2VTNXDE4Q_2)
 

 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 If the button doesn't work, here is the link: https://lasclay.com/en-us/collections/garden (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KNC6QS6BW8DW65X2VTNXDE4Q_3)​ (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KNC6QS6BW8DW65X2VTNXDE4Q_4) 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Thank you so much KELLY , and Happy Easter! 🐣🐰 

 Warmly,

messages.subject: Re: Plant milkweed - Huge discount on seeds! 🦋
messages.text:
Hello Kelly,
 

 We are truly sorry to hear that the germination of your milkweed seeds did not meet your expectations.
 

 Milkweed is especially close to our hearts, it plays a vital role in biodiversity, and we truly care about seeing it thrive in each of our customers’ gardens. 
 

 With this in mind, we will arrange a replacement for your order. We sincerely hope this new attempt will allow you to fully enjoy the beauty and benefits of milkweed.
 

 Please don’t hesitate to keep us updated, it would be a real pleasure to hear how it goes.
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay
